subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps — Acme MAP Recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme discovery recap & proposed Mutual Action Plan

Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. The notes below capture pain, goals, stakeholders, and suggested milestones. I attached a MAP spreadsheet (acme-map-v1.xlsx) that we can iterate on.

TL;DR:
- Pain: interactive map feature is slow at scale (timeouts at ~5–10k concurrent sessions) and current vendor limits caching/quantization options.
- Goal: reduce 99th percentile latency to <400ms for tile fetch + inference, support 20k concurrent sessions, and cut per-request inference cost by ~35% vs current baseline.
- Critical constraint: must run in customer VPC for PHI workflows; SOC 2 evidence required.

Proposed MAP (high-level):
1) Week of Mar 29 — Technical deep-dive + sample dataset exchange (stakeholders: Engineering PM, Platform Eng).
2) Apr 5 — Proof-of-concept (POC) kickoff: Redwood Dedicated node for 2-week POC (stakeholders: Platform Eng, Security).
3) Apr 19 — POC results & perf benchmarking (metrics: p99 latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens).
4) May 3 — Procurement & legal review; finalize SLA and pricing (Procurement, Legal).
5) May 17 — Decision/rollout plan; contract signature target.

Open questions / asks for your team:
- Who will be the primary technical contact for dataset access and VPC setup?
- Any blackout dates or procurement lead times we should know about?
- Are there minimum security artifacts you need from us beyond SOC 2 (e.g., penetration test report)?

Next steps (from our side): I’ll share the MAP spreadsheet and a short appendix describing required VPC peering steps and SOC 2 artifacts. Kimberly will coordinate SOW/pricing once we agree POC scope. Nikhil will prepare an infra sizing estimate for the POC.

If the plan looks good to you, please reply with stakeholder names + any date constraints and we’ll lock in the kickoff.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-map-v1.xlsx

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme discovery recap & proposed Mutual Action Plan

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap — this aligns well with what we discussed. Quick answers and additions:

- Primary technical contact: Tom Reed (cc’d) will lead engineering tasks and coordinate dataset share.
- Security contact: I’ll loop in our InfoSec team in a follow-up thread; they’ll want SOC 2 plus a short architecture diagram.
- Procurement lead time: We typically need ~3 weeks once SOW is agreed; ideal target for contract execution is mid-May.
- Blackout dates: We have a release freeze Apr 8–12. Avoid that week for any disruptive testing.

Regarding the MAP, small edits:
- Move POC kickoff to Apr 12 (post-freeze) and extend POC to 3 weeks (Apr 12–May 3) so Platform Eng has time to validate in our staging environment.
- Add a milestone for Security review (week of Apr 19).

I’ve attached the initial procurement intake form (procurement@acmecorp.com) — please include a high-level cost estimate in the SOW.

Jane
Director, Product — Acme Corporation
jane.doe@acmecorp.com | +1 212-555-0100

- Security review: week of Apr 19 (Redwood InfoSec to provide SOC 2 + architecture note).
- Procurement: target contract sign by May 17 to align with your timelines.

Action items I’m taking now:
- Kimberly: draft SOW + high-level pricing for a 3-week POC (cc’d).
- Nikhil: infra sizing and cost estimate for Dedicated nodes (cc’d).
- Marissa: schedule technical deep-dive with Tom for Mar 29 (or a date that works for your team).

Kimberly / Nikhil — could you both confirm you have what you need to start the SOW/estimates?

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for the Mar 29 deep-dive tentatively and include a link to the MAP spreadsheet in Drive.

Best,
Marissa
